scope_note: Mixed producer (integrated mine + processing + export of ferroniobium/special niobium products; includes the margin on sales to its own foreign sales subsidiaries). Individual P&L includes 'Lucros não realizados nos estoques das controladas' (elimination of CBMM's unrealised profit on goods still held by the foreign subsidiaries) of R$+225.2m in 2016 – intra-group timing item, left in. CODEMIG SCP: CBMM is the ostensive partner of a 1972 'sociedade em conta de participação' with the MG state company CODEMIG, which receives 25% of the SCP result; the SCP covers CBMM's whole niobium business (2022 SCP net sales R$10,953.8m = CBMM individual net revenue; SCP LAIR 2022 R$8,070.2m / 2021 R$9,053.3m, i.e. above CBMM's own LAIR; CODEMIG's 25% = R$2,017.6m pre-tax 2022, R$1,360.5m after its share of SCP IR/CS) (BRA_Codemge_DF_2022.pdf PDF p.2 note 1(c), p.9 note 22). CODEMIG's share therefore appears to be charged before CBMM's LAIR, while the SCP's IRPJ/CSLL is paid by CBMM and CODEMIG reimburses its part (R$588.7m in Jan-2023 for 2022; R$651.8m in Jan-2022 for 2021) – CBMM's cash tax thus includes tax economically borne by CODEMIG. CODEMIG (state-owned, Brazil-only) files no CbCR. Ore is mined by COMIPA (JV 49% CBMM / 51% CODEMIG, equity-accounted, sole client the SCP) – not in CBMM's CbCR. Consolidated PBT / cash tax: not published (only individual statements).
